name: the rule: insufficient material
note: The engine's draw by material (python-chess's has_insufficient_material, the spec's `draw`): a sufficient criterion of FIDE 5.2.2's dead position, not the rule itself; its no-knight cases are dead positions for every continuation (Ideas.DeadPosition.dead_of_spec_draw), its knight clause in the position only -- the obstacle of the store's `dead position (the knight clause)`, so a CONJECTURE; and FIDE's dead positions beyond the criterion (a locked pawn chain) are not the spec's (Ideas.LegalEquiv.terminal_complete).
